Prep time: 5 minutes Cook time: 0 minutes Total time: 5 minutes Number of Servings: 4 Ingredients 3/4 cup frozen blueberries 1 ripe banana 1 cup vanilla soy milk 3 ounces silken tofu 1/2 cup orange juice (juice from 1 orange) 1 teaspoon lime juice Directions Wash hands with soap and water. Combine all ingredients in a blender. Puree until completely smooth. Serve immediately. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours. Notes: Add 2-3 more teaspoons of lime juice for more tartness. Freeze extra lime juice to use later.
